pages.title: Xianeng Electricity Crystal
pages.text: The Xianeng Electricity Crystal is the unconditional FE variant in the Xianeng Crystal family. It shares structure, UI, fuel, and cache rules with the optional Xianeng Mana Crystal and Xianeng Source Crystal; see Crystal Integrations in the Mod Integration category for those addon-specific behaviors.

The UI always has three machine slots: processing, fuel, and extra output. The large right-hand meter shows the current long-valued FE cache and its limit. The default cache limit is 800,000,000 FE, and hovering the meter shows current/maximum values. The processing slot accepts rechargeable items and Certus-quartz-like items that expose a charged counterpart; completed results enter the extra slot.

The fuel slot accepts Immortal Yuan or True Yuan directly, or an owned Spirit Drive whose owner is online as a reusable payment credential. Binding follows this order: inside a player's personal realm, the realm owner wins; outside a personal realm, the crystal falls back to the Spirit Drive in its fuel slot. With no valid binding, Xianqiao Output cannot be enabled. Closing Xianqiao Output stops automatic Immortal Yuan refill only for a personal-realm source with an empty fuel slot; Spirit Drive replacement fuel remains independent of this switch.

Before Xianqiao Output can be enabled, the bound player must have unlocked stage-eight external resource storage and a usable FE endpoint. Enabling it flushes all local FE into the owner's Xianqiao and leaves the local cache at zero; the FE capability, AE2/RS access, and meter then point to that player's FE ledger. Above 800,000,000 FE, the meter remains full. Closing it only detaches the ledger and resumes a local cache from zero; it never pulls Xianqiao FE back into the crystal.

Xianqiao Output and Automatic Output are independent switches. Xianqiao Output controls whether the resource cache is bound to the owner's Xianqiao; Automatic Output controls active pushes to adjacent blocks on the six faces. Each face also has its own switch. Turning one switch off never changes the other. Without a binding, resources remain in the local cache, while the FE capability still registers and remains interactive.

While running, the crystal generates 1,000 FE per server tick; change this with energy_crystal.fePerTick, and change the cache limit with energy_crystal.feCapacity. Resource priority is: charge the processing item first, push to enabled faces second, and offer the remainder to Xianqiao last. Every allowed face attempts the complete available cache every tick, with no additional artificial rate limit.

Item-face rules are fixed: the top accepts processing input only, the four horizontal sides accept fuel only, and the bottom accepts no item input. Resource output uses the enabled faces. Automatic item output from the extra slot is bottom-only and requires both Automatic Output and the bottom-face switch. Bottom resource output and bottom extra-slot extraction are separate channels.

The processing slot continuously handles a full input stack one item at a time: rechargeable items charge in place and move one completed item into the extra slot; Certus-quartz-like items take 50 ticks and move their charged counterpart there. Charging consumes all currently available cache through the transfer bridge and is not capped by the 1,000-FE generation setting. The extra slot cannot accept manual input, is never written to Xianqiao, and can only be taken by the player or extracted from below; a full extra slot safely pauses processing.

The Xianeng Electricity Crystal declares FE storage whether or not any other power mod is installed. AE2 and RS use their long-valued storage interfaces over the same FE ledger, so quantities do not wrap into a 32-bit negative value. The crystal emits light level 15 while burning and is dark when idle.
